question: A baker makes 24 muffins in the morning and 18 in the afternoon. She sells 35 of them. How many muffins are left?
Tom has 3 boxes with 12 pencils in each box. He gives away 9 pencils. How many pencils does he have now?
A train travels at 80 km per hour for 2.5 hours. How many kilometers does it travel?
A shirt costs $40. It is on sale for 25% off. What is the sale price in dollars?
Maria reads 15 pages a day. How many days will it take her to finish a 360-page book?
A garden is 12 meters long and 7 meters wide. A fence goes around the whole garden. How many meters of fence are needed?
Jake earns $14 per hour and works 6 hours a day for 5 days. How much does he earn in total, in dollars?
There are 30 students in a class. Two fifths of them walk to school and the rest take the bus. How many students take the bus?
A tank holds 500 liters. Starting empty, it is filled at 20 liters per minute. After 13 minutes, how many more liters are needed to fill it?
Lena buys 4 notebooks at $2.50 each and a pen for $1.75. She pays with a $20 bill. How much change does she get, in dollars?
A recipe needs 3 eggs for every 2 cups of flour. How many eggs are needed for 10 cups of flour?
Sam is 4 times as old as his daughter. In 6 years, the sum of their ages will be 62. How old is Sam now?
A store had 120 apples. On Monday it sold one third of them, and on Tuesday it sold half of the remaining apples. How many apples are left?
A car uses 6 liters of fuel per 100 km. Fuel costs $1.50 per liter. How much does the fuel cost for a 450 km trip, in dollars?
Three friends split a bill of $96 equally, and each of them also adds a $4 tip. How much does each friend pay in total, in dollars?
A cyclist rides 18 km on Monday, twice that distance on Tuesday, and 9 km less than Tuesday on Wednesday. How many kilometers does she ride over the three days?
A school orders 7 boxes of chalk with 24 sticks in each box. After a month, 59 sticks have been used. How many sticks remain?
The temperature was -4 degrees at 6 am and rose by 3 degrees every hour. What was the temperature at 11 am?
A rectangle has a perimeter of 50 cm and a length of 15 cm. What is its area in square centimeters?
Anna saves $12 every week. She already has $30. After how many weeks will she have exactly $150?
A pack of 6 juice boxes costs $4.20. How much does one juice box cost, in dollars?
